notes.title: Text Wormhole is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello all, 

Welcome to the Steam version of Text Wormhole! 

Thank you to everyone for the support of our games. Also, please if you enjoyed Text Wormhole make sure to leave a brief Steam review for it if you can.

We're doing a 33% discount for the first week, bringing it down to $0.66 from $0.99!

You can contact our support team here[contact@elknight.com]if you have any issues.
We hope you enjoy it and happy gaming :)

Bryan

notes.title: Text Wormhole V1.10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We would greatly appreciate if a variety of players could test it out.

Text Wormhole V1.10 Patch Notes:
--> Keyboard control sensitivity increase
--> There is no death judgment after the end of each round of the game
--> Added 2 players leaderboards
--> Game difficulty adjustment
--> The difficulty of the game was adjusted
--> Added QUOTE feature!

Thank you to everyone that has been playing so far. We really appreciate it.

-Elknight Team

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30895002/3f2098b3edafe2274b4470b9b6c35fbf9ae217b7.png[/img]
